Oracle.title: Oracle, databases and critical infrastructures
Oracle.p1: Oracle environments often support an organization's most sensitive applications: business data, transactions, reporting, digital services, internal applications and production platforms. Their availability, performance and security have a direct impact on the business.
Oracle.p2: SMART2D accompanies companies in the design, administration, audit, migration, supervision and optimization of their Oracle platforms and the technical foundations surrounding them.
Oracle.cta_title: Do you run a critical Oracle environment?
Oracle.cta_desc: Request an audit or a technical discussion to identify risks, priorities and stabilization actions.
Oracle.sec1_desc: SMART2D intervenes in daily and advanced administration operations: installation, configuration, instance management, supervision, backup, recovery, patching, tuning, incident analysis and environment documentation.
Oracle.sec2_desc: Critical environments must be designed to withstand incidents. SMART2D accompanies the implementation and operation of availability, replication, backup and disaster recovery mechanisms.
Oracle.sec3_desc: A poorly optimized database can slow down a whole business chain. SMART2D analyzes queries, resources, parameters, indexes, wait events and operation practices to propose concrete actions.
Oracle.sec4_desc: Security does not just depend on a tool. It also relies on configuration, access management, permissions, backups, logs, system hardening and regular follow-up of best practices.
Oracle.sec5_desc: SMART2D accompanies paths towards Oracle Cloud Infrastructure: architecture, migration, hybrid integration, cloud security, backup, supervision, cost optimization and service continuity.
Oracle.sec6_desc: Oracle databases rely on system foundations that must be mastered. SMART2D intervenes on Oracle Linux, Red Hat, AIX, Solaris and Unix/Linux environments for administration, hardening, logs, access, patching and supervision.
